quantizationCaveat: NOT a same-bytes comparison. wllama reads GGUF Q4 (microsoft/Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct-gguf) while Zero-TVM reads MLC q4f16_1, so this compares a runtime AND a quantization together — unlike the WebLLM pair in phi3-mini.json, where both engines load byte-identical weight files.
protocol: same-session interleaved pair, greedy, cache_prompt=false so every run pays a full prefill; Zero-TVM 128-token target x 5 runs + warmup (q4f16_1, /local-weights), wllama 120-token target x 3 runs + warmup (GGUF, /local-gguf), enable_thinking=false on both halves; medians

falsificationControl.note: 3.0x wall-clock / 2.7x decode below the WebGPU run — confirms the GPU is doing the work.

notes: bench/results.json is NOT written under BENCH_BASELINE=wllama (its webllmDecode field feeds sync-docs.mjs and the published headline; a GGUF number there would be mislabelled). This file is the durable record. Zero-TVM's WebLLM-paired half the same day measured 69.70 total / 83.20 decode; the 68.15 here is the same engine in the wllama session. See BENCH.md 'Third baseline: llama.cpp via wllama (WebGPU)'.
